properties.name: Venice
properties.gapNote: No article for the Republic of Venice.

properties.name: Bulgar Khanate
properties.gapNote: No article. The Codex's First Bulgarian Empire is a different, later state.

properties.name: Principality of Kyiv
properties.gapNote: No article for the principality as distinct from Kievan Rus.

properties.name: Principality of Novgorod
properties.gapNote: No article for the Novgorod polity; the Codex's Novgorod is the city.

properties.name: Cuman Khanates
properties.linkNote: A people and a confederation rather than a state with institutions. The Codex covers the Cumans as a civilization.

properties.name: Papal States
properties.linkNote: The Papacy is an institution in the Codex, not a territory. The polygon is the temporal state it governed.

properties.name: Angevin Empire
properties.linkNote: Not a state with institutions of its own but the lands the Plantagenets held on both sides of the Channel at once. The link is to the house, because that is what actually held them together.
